Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: drdo.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 13-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO RCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DRDO RCI Recruitment 2026 is 13th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 vacancies announced for the Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow positions at Research Centre Imarat (DRDO RCI).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts?
faq.answer: For JRF posts, candidates need to have a First Class B.E/B.Tech with a valid GATE score, or M.E/M.Tech, or M.Sc with NET/GATE/SLET in the relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for DRDO RCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DRDO RCI Recruitment 2026. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DRDO RCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves scrutiny of applications, followed by a written test, interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q7. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application for DRDO RCI Recruitment 2026 must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to send their filled application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The stipend for both Research Associate (RA) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions will be as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Research Centre Imarat (DRDO RCI) located?
faq.answer: Research Centre Imarat (DRDO RCI) is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500069.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any state can apply for this recruitment, provided they meet the eligibility criteria and follow the application procedure correctly.
